Name: ToolSense - Smart AutoTool
Author: HoangTuDaa18
Description:
[quote][center][color=#ff7700][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b]About This Mod[/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[/quote][b][color=#00ff00] [/color][color=#6d9eeb]ToolSense[/color][/b] was created to make tool management in Stardew Valley more convenient and intuitive.
 As someone who used to play on mobile,i found it frustrating that[color=#ff7700] [u]PC players [/u][/color]had to constantly switch between different tools depending   on what they were doing. [color=#6d9eeb][b]ToolSense[/b] [/color]aims to reduce these repetitive actions by automatically selecting the appropriate tool based on   your target and current situation.
 Beyond automatic tool selection,the mod also helps manage toolbar selection during different activities,including exploration and   combat.It can even learn from your manual tool selections, gradually adapting to your personal preferences over time.
[b][color=#00ff00] [/color][color=#6d9eeb]ToolSense[/color][/b] helps you spend less time managing your toolbar,avoid unnecessary actions,and enjoy a smoother gameplay experience.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1794365171-267225061.png[/img]

[quote][center][size=5][color=#ff7700][font=Comic Sans MS]✦ Features[/font][/color][/size][/center]
[/quote][b][size=4][color=#6fa8dc][font=Comic Sans MS]1. Intelligent Automatic Tool Selection[/font][/color][/size][/b]
ToolSense automatically recognizes your target and selects the most suitable available tool, so you can focus on what you're doing instead of constantly switching toolbar slots.
[list]
[*][color=#ff7700][b]Axe:[/b] [/color]Automatically selects an axe when targeting trees and other suitable targets.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Pickaxe:[/color][/b] Selects a pickaxe when targeting rocks and other suitable targets.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Hoe:[/color][/b] Selects a hoe when targeting artifact spots and designated diggable targets.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Watering Can:[/color][/b] Selects a watering can when targeting soil that needs watering.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Scythe:[/color][/b] Selects a scythe when targeting grass, weeds, and suitable crops.[/*]
[*][color=#ff7700]Automatically[/color] selects your watering can when its water level falls below your configured refill threshold.[/*]
[*][color=#ff7700]Automatically[/color] selects your fishing rod when your watering can doesn't need refilling.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#ff0000][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]2. Combat Assist & Combat Mode[/font][/size][/color][/b]
Combat shouldn't be interrupted by unnecessary toolbar management. ToolSense helps you stay equipped and ready when enemies are nearby.
[list]
[*][b][color=#ff0000]Combat Assist:[/color][/b] Automatically selects the best available weapon in your toolbar when targeting a monster within the configured range.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff0000]Combat Mode:[/color][/b] Keeps your weapon equipped while enemies are nearby, preventing unwanted switches to regular tools when targeting grass, soil, or water.[/*]
[*]Customize enemy detection range and weapon restoration delay.[/*]
[*]Optionally ignore Slimes inside the Slime Hutch.[/*]
[/list][color=#6aa84f][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b]3. Hold to Sweep & Target Stability[/b][/font][/size][/color]
Designed for continuous gameplay, these features help [b][color=#a4c2f4]ToolSense[/color][/b] respond naturally as you move between targets.
[list]
[*][b][color=#ffff00]Hold to Sweep:[/color][/b] Continuously checks your target while holding the use-tool button, allowing ToolSense to switch tools as you move between targets.[/*]
[*][b][color=#6d9eeb]Target Stability:[/color][/b] Reduces unnecessary tool switching when moving your cursor across multiple targets by requiring a target to remain stable for a configurable number of checks.[/*]
[/list][color=#00ffff][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b]4. Smart Restore[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[b][color=#a4c2f4]ToolSense[/color] [/b]remembers your original toolbar selection before automatically switching tools, then restores it once the action sequence is complete.
Customize the restoration delay or disable this feature entirely to suit your playstyle.
[color=#d5a6bd][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b]5. Habit Learning (v2.0)[/b][/font][/size][/color]
Not every player uses the same tools for the same situations.[b][color=#6d9eeb]ToolSense[/color][/b] observes your repeated manual selections and gradually adapts to your preferences.
When you repeatedly switch to another tool immediately after [b][color=#6d9eeb]ToolSense[/color][/b] makes a selection for the same type of target, it remembers your preferred choice and uses it next time.
[list]
[*][color=#d5a6bd][b]Learns[/b][/color] from repeated manual tool overrides.[/*]
[*][b][color=#d5a6bd]Customize[/color][/b] how many overrides are required before a preference is learned.[/*]
[*][color=#d5a6bd][b]Learned habits[/b][/color] are saved separately for each save file.[/*]
[*]Reset[color=#d5a6bd][b] learned habits[/b][/color] whenever you like.[/*]
[*][b][color=#d5a6bd][NEW!!!] Mod added an object ToolSense doesn't recognize? Don't worry![/color][/b] Just use your tools manually until you succeed.[b][color=#6fa8dc] ToolSense[/color][/b] will learn from your actions and handle it automatically next time![/*]
[/list][b][color=#ff7700][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]6. Customization & Controller Support[/font][/size][/color][/b]
Fine-tune how [b][color=#a4c2f4]ToolSense [/color][/b]behaves to match [color=#ff7700]your personal playstyle.[/color]
[list]
[*]Configure individual tool selections and gameplay behaviors.[/*]
[*]Customize detection ranges, thresholds, and restoration delays.[/*]
[*]Supports [b][color=#ff7700]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/color][/b] for convenient in-game configuration ([color=#ff7700]optional dependency[/color]).[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][color=#ff7700]Controller Support (v1)[/color]
ToolSense now supports controller buttons and button combinations for its toggle hotkey, making it easier to enable or disable the mod while playing with a controller.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1794419625-1772146741.png[/img]
[quote][center][color=#ff7700][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b]⚠️ Important Notes[/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[/quote]Before using ToolSense, please keep the following points in mind:
[list]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Avoid using other automatic tool-selection mods.[/color][/b] If you are already using another mod with functionality similar to [color=#6d9eeb][b]ToolSense[/b][/color], I strongly recommend not using it alongside[color=#6d9eeb] [b]ToolSense[/b][/color], as conflicts may occur.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Compatibility:[/color][/b] [b][color=#6d9eeb]ToolSense[/color][/b] is currently at its first release. It may not be fully compatible with certain mods that modify toolbar behavior or tool selection. Compatibility may be improved in future updates.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Recommended Settings:[/color][/b] The default [color=#ff7700]GMCM[/color] configuration is recommended for the intended gameplay experience. Unless you have a specific reason to change something, I recommend keeping the default settings.[/*]
[/list][quote][center][color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b]📥 Installation[/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[/quote][list=1]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Install SMAPI[/color][/b] (version 4.0.0 or later) if you haven't already.[/*]
[*][b]Download ToolSense[/b] and extract the downloaded ZIP file.[/*]
[*]Move the
[code]ToolSense-AutoTool[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] to configure ToolSense directly in-game.[/*]
[/list]That's it! [color=#6d9eeb][b]ToolSense[/b][/color] is ready to use.
[b]Note:[/b] Make sure the folder structure looks like this:
[code]Stardew Valley/
└── Mods/
    └── ToolSense-AutoTool/
        ├── assets/
        ├── i18n/
        ├── AutoTool.dll
        ├── config.json
        └── manifest.json[/code][quote][center][color=#00ff00][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS]🐛 Bug Reports & Feedback[/font][/size][/color][/center]
[/quote][b][color=#6d9eeb]ToolSense[/color][/b] is still a new mod, so there may be issues that I haven't encountered during development or testing.
If you encounter any bugs, unexpected behavior, or compatibility issues, I would really appreciate it if you could report them in the Nexus comments or the Bugs section.
When reporting an issue, providing the following information would be very helpful:
[list]
[*]A description of the issue and how to reproduce it.[/*]
[*]Your SMAPI log.[/*]
[*]A list of other mods that may be related to the issue.[/*]
[/list]Your reports and feedback are incredibly valuable. They help me identify problems, improve compatibility, and make [color=#6d9eeb][b]ToolSense[/b][/color] better for everyone.
Thank you for trying ToolSense and supporting my work. And if you're enjoying the mod, don't hesitate to leave it an[color=#6aa84f] [b]Endorsement[/b]![/color] 💚
